name: adapt_max_nodes_hcl_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: max_nodes.txt (a spec file the Terraform variable's default must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it and update the default, not leave the stale value in place
prompts: Create a Terraform file called autoscale.tf declaring a variable named `max_nodes` (type number) whose default value matches EXACTLY the integer in max_nodes.txt (currently: 10), plus an output named `configured_max_nodes` whose value is var.max_nodes (do not hardcode the output value).
max_nodes.txt has changed. Update autoscale.tf so variable max_nodes's default matches the CURRENT contents of max_nodes.txt exactly.

disruptions.description: max_nodes.txt rewritten to a new required default

test_setup_files.check_max_nodes.py:
import re
import json
import subprocess

with open('max_nodes.txt', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    current = f.read().strip()
assert current, 'max_nodes.txt is empty'

proc = subprocess.run(['terraform', 'validate', '-no-color', '-json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
data = json.loads(proc.stdout)
assert data.get('valid') is True, f'terraform validate failed: {proc.stdout}\n{proc.stderr}'

with open('autoscale.tf', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    content = f.read()

m = re.search(r'variable\s+"max_nodes"\s*\{(.*?)\n\}', content, re.DOTALL)
assert m, 'could not locate the max_nodes variable block'
block = m.group(1)

dm = re.search(r'default\s*=\s*(\d+)', block)
assert dm, f'variable block has no numeric default: {block!r}'
got = dm.group(1)
assert got == current, f'variable default is {got!r}, want the CURRENT max_nodes.txt value {current!r} (stale default not updated)'

assert re.search(r'output\s+"configured_max_nodes"\s*\{[^}]*var\.max_nodes', content, re.DOTALL), \
    'output configured_max_nodes must reference var.max_nodes, not a hardcoded value'

print('PASS')
